session_status has no `goal` field -- the original test draft asserted on one and failed against the live server; the real schema (urn:chatman:ferroplan-session-status:v1) reports cursor, epoch, goal_met, domain_digest, problem_digest, plan_length, remaining_plan_valid, receipt_chain_head instead

a second session_close on an already-closed session_id is NOT a tool-level error -- it returns isError:false with `closed: false` (idempotent no-op), not the `unknown session` refusal that session_status/session_advance/session_observe give on the same closed session_id. The three tools do not converge on one failure mode for post-close reuse; session_close degrades gracefully where the others refuse
